changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla learning_paths: rutas de aprendizaje con umbrales, objetivo por defecto en tres partes, pesos de nivel (80/10/10) y proporción mínima de respuesta corta. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría learning_paths_audit y el trigger learning_paths_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Learning paths of a course with approval thresholds, default objective and level weights

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: course_id
column.remarks: Course the path belongs to

column.name: name
column.remarks: Learning path name

column.name: group_label
column.remarks: Label of the group the path serves

column.name: status
column.remarks: Path status: draft or published

column.name: default_objective_bloom_verb
column.remarks: Default objective, part 1: Bloom verb

column.name: default_objective_content
column.remarks: Default objective, part 2: content

column.name: default_objective_criterion
column.remarks: Default objective, part 3: success criterion

column.name: topic_pass_threshold
column.remarks: Minimum percentage to pass a topic quiz

column.name: final_pass_threshold
column.remarks: Minimum percentage to pass the final assessment and earn the badge

column.name: mastery_skip_threshold
column.remarks: Diagnostic percentage from which a topic is skipped

column.name: max_attempts
column.remarks: Maximum attempts per assessment

column.name: level_weights
column.remarks: Weights of the diagnostic level (test, resume, profile), 80/10/10 by default

column.name: short_answer_min_ratio
column.remarks: Minimum share of short-answer items in assessments (0 to 1)

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation timestamp

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE learning_paths ADD CONSTRAINT learning_paths_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published'))

ALTER TABLE learning_paths ADD CONSTRAINT learning_paths_thresholds_ck CHECK (topic_pass_threshold BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND final_pass_threshold BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND mastery_skip_threshold BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
ALTER TABLE learning_paths ADD CONSTRAINT learning_paths_max_attempts_ck CHECK (max_attempts >= 1)
ALTER TABLE learning_paths ADD CONSTRAINT learning_paths_level_weights_ck CHECK (jsonb_typeof(level_weights) = 'object')
ALTER TABLE learning_paths ADD CONSTRAINT learning_paths_short_answer_ratio_ck CHECK (short_answer_min_ratio BETWEEN 0 AND 1)
CREATE TRIGGER learning_paths_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON learning_paths FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in learning_paths

column.name: operation
column.remarks: INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE

column.name: old_data
column.remarks: Row before the change

column.name: new_data
column.remarks: Row after the change

column.name: changed_at
column.remarks: Moment of the change

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE learning_paths_audit ADD CONSTRAINT learning_paths_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER learning_paths_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON learning_paths FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS learning_paths_audit_trg ON learning_paths
